description: This file defines a pipeline behavior for handling database transactions within the ASP.NET Core application, specifically implementing the MediatR IPipelineBehavior to manage transaction scope around request handling.

classes.name: DBContextTransactionPipelineBehavior
classes.description: A MediatR pipeline behavior that wraps request handlers with database transaction management, ensuring that all database operations inside a request are committed or rolled back atomically.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the execution of the request within a database transaction, initiating a transaction before processing and committing or rolling back depending on success or exception.
